column1: # SQL-only objects: created on purpose by custom migrations, not expressible in the Drizzle
# schema (ADR-0039 archive and audit, ADR-0040 webhook definer). scripts/check-schema-sql.sh
# requires each to exist in the migrated database with exactly this definition hash, and compares
# everything else with the schema. One object per line: <kind>\t<name>\t<sha256 of definition>.
# A new or changed object: review its migration, then copy the line the gate prints.
